name: Buffalo Wild Wings
red_flags: Guide PDF (valid 08/18-11/17/2026) is linked from the nutrition page; filename changes each quarter. Wings and fries fried in beef tallow in shared fryers. Bone-in wings marked 'may contain' wheat/gluten. Many sauces/rubs contain milk or egg. No items certified gluten-free. Several sauces show no listed allergens (Blazin' Knockout, Caribbean Jerk, Golden Fire, Honey BBQ, Hot, Mango Habanero, Sweet BBQ, Wild), but the wings themselves carry the wheat/gluten 'may contain' note.

name: Olive Garden
red_flags: Chart says the kitchen can't guarantee any item is allergen-free. Fryer and grill are marked as special cross-contact risks. Pastas with and without egg share one pasta cooker, and the gluten-free rotini contains egg. Every pasta has wheat or egg. Fries go in the shared soy-oil fryer. The sirloin contains dairy.
likely_safe: Italian sausage with marinara (contains soy only)
Tomato sauce or marinara (marinara contains soy)

name: Red Lobster
red_flags: Shellfish-centric kitchen, so shellfish cross-contact risk is high. Chart (valid 10/12-11/15/2026) says shared prep areas and that cross-contact can't be eliminated. Fried items share a soybean-oil blend fryer with shellfish. Sides and sauces are listed separately. The site blocks some automated requests.
likely_safe: Baked potato, plain (no butter or sour cream)

name: LongHorn Steakhouse
red_flags: Allergen chart is pp. 18-23 of the combined nutrition/gluten-sensitive/allergen PDF (valid 11/4/26). Grilled items are flagged for grill cross-contact, and shrimp and lobster are cooked on the grill. NOTE: Honey Glazed Carrots contain PEANUT. Steak tips and Churrasco contain wheat and gluten. Fresh steamed broccoli and asparagus contain dairy.
likely_safe: Flo's Filet, Renegade Sirloin, Ribeye or NY Strip (chart shows no allergens; grill cross-contact)

name: Outback Steakhouse
red_flags: Searchable on-page table (Top 9, created Sept 2026). It has no separate gluten column and lists no barley or malt. Fried items share a fryer with beef tallow; Outback says 'we do not recommend that guests with allergies order fried foods' (so skip Aussie Fries). Steaks and most entrees list milk.
likely_safe: Outback Ribs (BBQ sauce; chart has no gluten/barley column, so ask)
Tangy Tomato, Light Balsamic or Mustard Vinaigrette dressings (salad itself not confirmed)

name: Bonefish Grill
red_flags: Searchable on-page Top-9 table with no gluten column. Shared fryer; Bonefish says 'we do not recommend that guests with allergies order fried foods'. Seafood-focused kitchen, so shellfish cross-contact is a risk.
likely_safe: 'Simply Grilled' fish such as salmon, mahi-mahi, sea bass, trout or grouper (fish and soy only)
Mango salsa or chimichurri as the sauce
Kids' steamed broccoli, green beans or spinach
House side salad with citrus herb vinaigrette

name: Carrabba's Italian Grill
red_flags: Searchable on-page Top-9 table with no gluten column. Some pasta is cooked in a shared pot (egg cross-contact). Seafood and gluten-free pastas are cooked separately.
likely_safe: Gluten Free Pasta with Pomodoro Sauce
Simply Grilled Salmon or Trout (fish only)

name: Maggiano's Little Italy
red_flags: PDF linked from the homepage. It combines wheat and gluten in one column and lists crustacean shellfish only. Shared fryers and grills. Nearly every pasta and entree contains milk and wheat, and steaks list milk.
likely_safe: Grilled chicken add-on (salad add-on), no sauce

name: Chili's
red_flags: Nutrition page links a Nutritionix interactive guide (restaurant.nutritionix.com/chilis/landing) and a printable 25-page Nutritionix PDF (updated 08/04/2026). Green/red dots per allergen; a blank box means 'not verified'. The chart doesn't address fryer sharing. I couldn't confirm multi-select because Nutritionix blocks automated access.
likely_safe: Guiltless Grill Chicken Platter (listed as served)
Steamed broccoli, asparagus or black beans

name: TGI Fridays
red_flags: Combined nutrition and allergen PDF ('as of 02.17.2026'); the filename changes. It has no gluten column. The chart says it can't guarantee any item is allergen-free and that shared cooking areas are used.

name: Red Robin
red_flags: 'Allergy-Friendly Menu' customizer (red-robin.widget.eagle.bigzpoon.com): you pick allergens to avoid and it builds a menu with modifications. The page wording implies multi-select, but I didn't test it. Sesame isn't confirmed on the page. Accommodated meals get a purple pick. I couldn't read the item data.

name: P.F. Chang's
red_flags: Allergen PDF ('holiday 2026') is linked from the nutrition page; the filename changes seasonally. There is no gluten column; gluten-free items are listed separately. Almost every dish, including the gluten-free menu, contains SHELLFISH plus egg and milk. Gluten-free pad thai contains peanuts. Of the main items, only steamed rice is clear. Poor fit.
likely_safe: Gluten-free steamed white or brown rice (the only clear item)

name: BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse
red_flags: 'Food Allergen Sensitivities Menu' (November 2026), linked from the menu page. It has a separate 'Other Gluten' column next to wheat, which helps screen for barley or rye but isn't labeled as barley. The chart notes shared prep areas, utensils and common fryer oil. Brewery-restaurant.

name: Bahama Breeze
red_flags: Allergen guide PDF (valid May 4, 2026) is linked from the food-allergies page. Grill and soybean-oil fryer items are flagged for cross-contact. The chart says it can't guarantee any item is allergen-free.

name: Seasons 52
red_flags: Valid Oct 23, 2026. No allergen info for alcoholic beverages. Shared preparation areas. Most entrees contain dairy, including the filet mignon and grilled chicken breast.
likely_safe: Wood-Grilled Kona-Crusted Lamb (happy hour; no allergens listed)

name: Yard House
red_flags: Combined 19-page nutrition, dietary and allergen guide. Grill and fryer items are flagged for cross-contact. It has a 'shared fryer' note on its gluten-sensitive items. Large beer bar.

name: Ruth's Chris Steak House
red_flags: PDF (media.ruthschris.com/en_us/pdf/ruths-chris-allergen-guide.pdf) covers corporate locations only, not franchises. Steaks and the baked potato list DAIRY (served with butter), and the kids' 4 oz filet lists dairy. French fries are marked gluten but not wheat (shared fryer or another gluten source). Grilled asparagus comes with hollandaise (egg, dairy, fish).

name: Benihana
red_flags: 2-page allergy guide PDF. It has a gluten column but no wheat column. It marks fryer cross-contamination, and 'O' means removable. Teppanyaki grills are shared with shrimp and other shellfish. Soy sauce and garlic butter are common.

name: True Food Kitchen
red_flags: Seasonal nutritional guide PDF (linked from the page; the filename changes). Each item has an allergen statement and a gluten statement. Every item also carries a cross-contact note ('may contain eggs, milk, wheat, ... peanuts, tree nuts').
likely_safe: Add-on grass-fed steak or antibiotic-free chicken (none of the 8 majors)
Honey roasted carrots or seasonal veggies
Guacamole with veggies instead of chips

name: Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen
red_flags: Allergen guide PDF (effective Nov 2, 2026; media.cheddars.com/images/site/pdf/Cheddars_Allergen_Guide.pdf). Grill and soybean-oil fryer items are flagged for cross-contact. Use the 'Gluten-Friendly' section: its items are modified versions.
likely_safe: Gluten-friendly House Smoked Baby Back Ribs
Gluten-friendly Original Burger (no bun, no cheese)

name: Firebirds Wood Fired Grill
red_flags: Allergen PDF dated 10.14.2026, linked from the health page. Wood-fired grill is shared with shrimp and lobster. Most steaks and the filet list MILK (butter).
likely_safe: Baby Back Ribs Dinner or Lunch (no allergens listed)
Chile Rub or Peppercorn Crust as a steak enhancement

name: First Watch
red_flags: Online per-item allergen table plus a PDF (fw-nutrition-info.s3.amazonaws.com/allergenguide.pdf). Shared toaster and equipment; the chart says gluten-free items are often prepped on shared equipment. Breakfast menu is heavy on egg, milk and wheat.

name: Keke's Breakfast Cafe
red_flags: Allergen guide PDF linked from the homepage. It has no gluten column. 'S' marks shared surfaces and equipment. A soy-based oil is used on all griddled items. Not a gluten-free or allergen-free environment.

name: Black Bear Diner
red_flags: Interactive EveryBite guide (app.everybite.com/widget/black-bear). Shared prep areas, equipment and fryers. I couldn't load the widget data, so multi-select isn't verified.

name: Domino's
red_flags: On-page X chart. It has no gluten column, and Domino's has a separate warning that its gluten-free crust isn't recommended for celiac (shared kitchen). The site disclaims responsibility for allergy sensitivities. The pizza sauce shows one allergen I couldn't map to a column. Cheese contains milk.
likely_safe: Plain chicken wings, no sauce (no allergens marked)

name: Papa John's
red_flags: Allergen grid (revised March 2026). A check means 'contains or is made, stored or processed with'. It has no gluten column. Papa John's says it assumes no responsibility for allergies, and the gluten-free crust isn't recommended for celiac.

name: Pizza Inn
red_flags: Y/N allergen profiles PDF (updated May 2026) with a separate 'Other Gluten' column. Buffet and salad bar format, so cross-contact risk is high. The chart says it can't guarantee freedom from cross-contact. I didn't verify fryer details for tots and wings.
likely_safe: Bone-in wings with wing sauce or Southwest seasoning (all N)
Salad bar vegetables with fat-free Italian dressing (all N; buffet cross-contact)

name: MOD Pizza
red_flags: Per-ingredient allergen page (updated July 2026) with ingredient lists. The standard crusts and croutons contain MALTED BARLEY. All items are made on one shared line, and no crust is recommended for gluten sensitivity. The allergen icons didn't come through when I read the page, so I confirmed no items.

name: Blaze Pizza
red_flags: The allergen page embeds a Nutritionix 'special diets' tool (nutritionix.com/blaze-pizza/menu/special-diets/premium). Nutritionix blocks automated access, so I couldn't read which allergens it covers or whether it allows multi-select.

name: Famous Dave's
red_flags: Allergen PDF (6-25-26) is linked from the nutrition page. Shared fryers. Brisket, pulled pork, pulled chicken and rib tips are marked GLUTEN but not wheat, which suggests a non-wheat gluten source such as barley or malt, so avoid them. Most sides contain milk. Sauces are listed separately.
likely_safe: Hell Fire pickles or jalapeno pickled onions

name: Sonny's BBQ
red_flags: Linked from the FAQ page, but the PDF is dated 2024 and may be stale. Single shared kitchen, and Sonny's says it can't guarantee any item is gluten- or allergen-free.

name: Dickey's Barbecue Pit
red_flags: Linked allergen profile PDF is dated 6/1/2022, so it's stale and should be reconfirmed. It uses a Y/N format with an 'Other Gluten' column.

name: Cold Stone Creamery
red_flags: 'Food Allergies and Sensitivities' PDF lists only 7 allergens (no fish, shellfish or gluten column). Chocolate Malt and Double Chocolate Malt ice creams are listed. Products may contain traces of egg, milk, peanuts, tree nuts and wheat from on-site prep; mix-ins are worked on shared stones.
likely_safe: Fruit sorbets such as lemon, orange, raspberry, strawberry or watermelon (no allergens marked; ask for a clean stone and spade)

name: Marble Slab Creamery
red_flags: June 2026 allergen, ingredient and nutrition PDF. The chart states ALL products are produced on and touch equipment used for ice cream with MILK, PEANUTS and TREE NUTS. It lists malted milk as an ingredient. Not suitable.

name: Nothing Bundt Cakes
red_flags: Ingredient lists with 'CONTAINS' lines. Every cake contains egg and milk, and they may contain traces of tree nuts and peanuts. Not suitable.

name: Crumbl
red_flags: The allergen page asks you to pick a store first because flavors rotate weekly, so I couldn't read the allergen data or which allergens are covered.
